title: CERF allocation report: Nepal, anticipatory action for floods (2021)
summary: Final report on CERF allocation 21-RR-NPL-48553: US$3.2 million disbursed in eastern Nepal after the readiness trigger of 13 August 2021; the unused balance was returned.

title: CERF allocation report: South Sudan, early action for floods (2022)
summary: Final report on CERF allocation 22-RR-SSD-52855 (US$14.99 million), early action ahead of the projected 2022 floods.

title: CERF allocation report: Nepal, anticipatory action for floods (2024)
summary: Final report on CERF allocation 24-RR-NPL-65081 (US$3.41 million), released when the Koshi basin framework was activated on 29 September 2024.

title: CERF allocation report: Niger, anticipatory action for floods (2024)
summary: Final report on CERF allocation CERF-NER-24-RR-1398 (US$5.0 million), anticipatory action ahead of the 2024 floods.
